FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 178
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Corey Harbison
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/23/2024
House Bill 178 as introduced would exempt certain food pantries located in Cullman County
from all state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes which would decrease receipts to the
Education Trust Fund, county, and municipal funds by an undetermined amount, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2025, dependent upon the amount of taxes that would otherwise be collected on
items purchased by the pantry for charitable purposes.
